faq.title: What people ask before they start

card.question: Do I need a credit card?
card.answer: No. You try the Pro plan for 14 days without a card. Then you pick a plan, or the account stays read-only and nothing is deleted.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Any time, in settings. You can export your data first.

mobile.question: Does it work on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes, the whole app in the browser, including the call timer. A native app is in the works.

game.question: Do I have to play?
game.answer: No. Switch the game mode off in settings and {appName} is a plain tool. Nothing gets locked and you lose nothing.

ai.question: What does Jarvis do with my data?
ai.answer: He sees only your deals, contacts and calendar and uses them only for your answers. Nothing is trained on customer data.

notFor.question: Who is {appName} not for?
notFor.answer: Companies with dozens of salespeople and approval processes. It is for people starting on their own or with a few workers.

contacts.question: Where do generated contacts come from?
contacts.answer: From public business listings via Google Places: name, address and phone. There are no e-mails in them. We watch the monthly limits and data protection rules.

usage.p1: To learn which parts of {appName} help and what needs to get better, we record how the app is used: which screens you open, which actions you take (such as creating a milestone or moving a contact), how long you spend in the app, what kind of device you use and which errors happened.
usage.p2: We store only types of actions, counts, times and states, never content: no names, phone numbers, e-mails, company, deal or task names, and no messages to Jarvis. The records are linked to your account, only the operator of {appName} can see them, and we use no tracking cookies or third-party services for this.
